title: Qingyao's Tears
next_chapter_hook: "When the complete content of the Fifth Page Prophecy flooded into her consciousness, Su Qingyao finally understood—their fates, hers and Chen Ling's, had been woven into the same deadly game by the Tianji Record many years ago."

text.content: "In the depths of the ruins, the air was thick with the mingled stench of decay and blood. The Tianji Record Fragment on Chen Ji's chest emitted a cold, ghostly glow, and the excruciating pain from the thirty percent fusion was spreading along his meridians to his internal organs. He forced himself to stay standing, gazing at the equally pale face before him—Ye Qing's eye corners had already seeped blood; the price of the 'Demonic Mist' concealing his aura was equally devastating."

"'The Heavenly Eye's pursuit will never stop.' Ye Qing's voice was hoarse and weary. 'Both of us are now on the brink of death.' Chen Ji didn't answer, for he knew better than anyone—the hidden curse buried within him by the thirty percent Tianji fusion was devouring his life force at a visible rate. Prophecies can see the future, but whether the seen future can be changed remains an unknown."

"Just then, a violent tremor came from the depths of the ruins. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—that was the sound of Tianqing Sect's distinctive 'Formation-Breaking Talisman' tearing through layers of restrictions. Following it, a white figure like a startled swan darted into view—Su Qingyao's dress had been torn by the restrictions into countless gashes, her hair disheveled, yet still carrying that incomparable凌厉的气势."

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ji!' Su Qingyao's voice echoed through the empty ruins, carrying uncontrollable trembling. 'You worthless wretch... how dare you hide this from me to such an extent!' Her eyes were red-rimmed, but no tears fell; she simply stared fixedly at the ghostly glow on Chen Ji's chest."

text.content: "Chen Ji gazed at that face twisted with fury and heartache, and absurdly, a warmth surged in his heart. This woman—ever since he'd entered the Tianqing Sect, she had been investigating him. She had gotten infinitely close to the truth three times, yet each time she'd been deceived by his carefully crafted illusions. Now she'd rushed into this place regardless of everything—was it foolishness, or..."

dialogue.content: "'Senior Sister Su, this place isn't where you should be.' Chen Ji's voice returned to its usual flatness, even carrying a hint of estrangement. 'The restrictions torn open by the Formation-Breaking Talisman will be tracked by the Heavenly Eye—you're seeking your own death.' He paused, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips. 'Or does the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow have such limited intellect?'"

"'You—!' Su Qingyao's entire body trembled with rage. She raised her hand to strike Chen Ji but stopped mid-swing. Her gaze fell on Chen Ji's pallid face, on the seeping bloodstains, and finally transformed into a low, hoarse question: 'Why didn't you tell me?'"

text.content: "However, at this moment, another figure slowly emerged from the shadows in the depths of the ruins. Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently—it was a young woman of similar age to Su Qingyao, with a face bearing seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji, yet carrying an otherworldly ethereal aura. Chen Nian, or rather, Chen Ling manifesting with complete will, had finally appeared before him."

"Chen Ling's appearance made the very air freeze. Her gaze first fell on Chen Ji, complex emotions swirling in her eyes, then shifted to Su Qingyao—a scrutinizing look, as if confirming something. After a moment, she spoke, her voice cold as ice: 'So it's you.'"

dialogue.content: "'Su Qingyao, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect.' Chen Ling stepped forward slowly, each step seemingly treading on the threads of fate. 'I've been waiting for you for a long time.' A meaningful smile curved her lips. 'Indeed, those chosen by the Tianji Record are all equally foolish.'"

text.content: "Su Qingyao was stunned by this sudden declaration. Instinctively, she positioned herself before Chen Ji: 'Who are you? Didn't Chen Ji's sister disappear long ago!' Yet the moment her question left her mouth, a violent dizziness suddenly assailed her—the Tianji Record's sensing ability had actively extended at this moment, connecting her to that ghostly glow."

dialogue.content: "'Do you feel it?' Chen Ling's voice sounded in Su Qingyao's mind, a communication method that bypassed the eardrums entirely. 'This is the price of the Tianji Record. Your fate, from the moment you first attempted to investigate the truth, has been bound to it.' She paused. 'And I... chose to let you see this truth.'"

choice.prompt: "What did it mean that Chen Ling actively shared the Tianji Record's sensing with Su Qingyao? Chen Ji had to make a choice:"

choices.description: "Forcefully interrupt the sensing connection and push Su Qingyao away from this vortex. The cost: her perceptual abilities would be permanently damaged."

text.content: "Chen Ji surged to his feet, forcefully channeling the Tianji Record's power to push Su Qingyao out of the sensing range. A mouthful of blood sprayed from his lips, and the agony of the sudden Heavenly Fate drain nearly made him collapse. 'Get lost!' His voice was hoarse and resolute. 'You're not needed here!'"

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao's eyes were filled with disbelief. Her body was pushed away by an invisible force, yet she struggled desperately, shouting: 'Chen Ji! You bastard! Do you think this will make me give up!' Tears finally spilled over."

choices.memory_label: 陈机为保护她付出代价

choices.description: "Let Su Qingyao see the truth; the three fates will intertwine from now on. The cost: her Heavenly Fate will begin draining slowly."
choices.risk_hint: "She may fall into greater danger because of this"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, allowing the Tianji Record's sensing to wrap around Su Qingyao. He could feel her consciousness intertwining with that ghostly light—a soul-level contact that evoked an unprecedented vulnerability within him. 'Since you want to know...' His voice was low. 'Then look.'"

dialogue.content: "The moment Su Qingyao's consciousness fully connected with the Tianji Record, she saw everything Chen Ji had endured alone all these years—the excruciating pain in the dead of night, the life force devoured by Heavenly Fate, and the deep-seated obsession he'd kept hidden in his heart: find his sister, make the Tianqing Sect pay the price."

choices.memory_label: 她终于理解了他的苦衷

choices.description: "Actively channel his Heavenly Fate to Su Qingyao, forming a Life-Bond connection. The cost: Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate drains significantly."

text.content: "Chen Ji didn't hesitate. He actively guided the Tianji Record's power toward Su Qingyao. A visible azure light burst from his body, flowing into Su Qingyao's brow center. That was pure Heavenly Fate—the very thing he'd accumulated over the years to preserve his life—yet now he handed it over without hesitation."

dialogue.content: "'You...' Su Qingyao's body trembled violently. That warm force was repairing her damaged meridians while also planting a seed within her. She suddenly understood—this wasn't just protection; it was handing over his most vulnerable self to her. 'Chen Ji, you've gone mad!' Her voice choked."

choices.memory_label: 他将最重要的东西交给了她

text.content: "Chen Ling watched this scene quietly, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes. The moment Su Qingyao and Chen Ji's fates thoroughly intertwined, she suddenly spoke: 'It's not enough.' Her voice was ice-cold and resolute. 'For the Heavenly Eye to truly cease its pursuit, you three must become the same destiny node.'"

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ling!' Chen Ji hissed. 'What are you saying!' But his warning came too late—Chen Ling's figure suddenly dissolved into a stream of light, entering Su Qingyao's brow center. Immediately, the Tianji Record's ghostly glow surged violently, pulling all three consciousnesses into a kaleidoscopic space simultaneously."

text.content: "That was the Tianji Record's inner space. The three consciousnesses floated amid endless starlight, surrounded by countless blurred images—past, future, all the threads of fate the Tianji Record had woven. And at the convergence point of all threads, a line of blood-red text slowly appeared."

"'When the sun, moon, and stars align as three luminaries in the heavens, the Gate of Sacrifice shall open. The Writer, the Prophet, the Keykeeper—as one they must combine to overturn fate and change destiny. Yet all three are kindling; one rises all rise, one burns all burn.' Chen Ling's voice echoed through this space, carrying an ancient sorrow."

choice.prompt: "The Fifth Page Prophecy revealed a cruel truth—all three were part of the sacrifice. Chen Ji had to make a choice:"

choices.description: "Forcefully sever the connection to the prophecy and bear all costs alone."

dialogue.content: "'Prophecy?' Chen Ji coldly laughed. He violently channeled all the Tianji Record's power. Those interwoven fate threads exploded around him, shattering into漫天碎屑. 'I, Chen Ji, never believed in fate.' His voice echoed through the space, carrying unyielding resolve. 'If this is the Tianji Record's arrangement—then I'll destroy it with my own hands.'"

choices.description: "Use the three fates' intertwining to create variables beyond the prophecy."
choices.visible_reward: "May find the key to breaking the situation"

text.content: "Chen Ji was silent for a moment, his gaze moving between Su Qingyao and Chen Ling. Suddenly, he spoke: 'The prophecy says all three must combine to overturn fate—what if the three aren't combined by fate, but actively choose to combine?' A calculating curve formed at his lips. 'Sacrifice requires passive victims... but what if we're the ones actively sacrificing?'"

choices.description: "Calmly accept the three fates' arrangement and face the final sacrifice together."
choices.risk_hint: "May become pawns of the Heavenly Eye"

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao suddenly stepped forward, grasping Chen Ji's hand. Her palm was warm, a stark contrast to the Tianji Record's coldness. 'If this is fate...' Her voice was soft but exceptionally firm. 'Then I choose to face it with you.' Chen Ling's figure reformed beside her; the three's gazes met in this moment."

text.content: "When the three emerged from the consciousness space, the air within the ruins had changed. A faint azure mark appeared on Su Qingyao's forehead—that was proof of her Life-Bond with Chen Ji. Chen Ling stood beside them both in complete form; the three's auras had formed some subtle resonance."

"'The Heavenly Eye's tracking... is broken.' Ye Qing's voice came from the distance, carrying disbelief. Chen Ji looked down at his chest—the Tianji Record's glow was dimmer than before, yet that suffocating sensation of fate gripping his throat had lessened considerably. After the three fates intertwined, the pursuit originally aimed solely at him had been dispersed."

dialogue.content: "'You knew this would happen all along, didn't you?' Su Qingyao's voice was hoarse; her eye sockets were still red, but her gaze was firmer than before. 'From the moment you deliberately let me investigate the truth, you were already plotting for today.' She paused, a bitter smile forming at her lips. 'You scoundrel... you used me from start to finish.'"

choice.prompt: "Su Qingyao's accusation froze the air; Chen Ji had to respond:"

choices.description: "Honestly admit everything was for strategy, but this was the only way to protect her."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: 'Yes.' His voice was soft, yet each word was clear. 'From the very beginning, I knew that only by making you believe you were investigating the truth would you willingly walk to this point.' He raised his head, meeting Su Qingyao's eyes directly. 'Because if I told you directly, you would never have believed it.'"

choices.description: "Insist he had other motives; dragging her into the scheme was for a greater goal."
choices.risk_hint: "May create a rift in the relationship"

dialogue.content: "'Use?' Chen Ji coldly laughed. 'Senior Sister Su overestimates herself.' He turned away, his back to Su Qingyao, his voice indifferent. 'I simply needed someone to divert the Heavenly Eye's attention. You happened to appear in the most suitable position; that's all.' His tone was ice-cold, but his clenched fists betrayed his true emotions."

choices.description: "No explanation, no defense. Some things, saying them would only cause harm."

text.content: "Chen Ji didn't answer. He simply stood there quietly, letting Su Qingyao's accusations fall upon him like blades. There were words he couldn't speak; some truths, he would rather she never know. Everything he did was never manipulation—but precisely because of that, he couldn't let anyone know."

"Just then, a strange tremor came from the depths of the ruins. The Tianji Record's glow lit up again, but this time it wasn't ghostly azure, but a piercing gold-crimson—that was the color that appeared only when the complete Fifth Page Prophecy was triggered. Chen Ji's expression changed sharply: 'No good... the Heavenly Eye has found a new method of tracking!'"

"Su Qingyao and Chen Ling simultaneously sensed that oppressive force. The three consciousnesses were pulled back into that kaleidoscopic space, but this time, what they saw wasn't past scenes—it was a complete prophecy—a final truth sealed within the Tianji Record's Fifth Page, one not even Chen Ji had ever seen."

"'When the sun, moon, and stars align as three luminaries in the heavens, the Gate of Sacrifice shall open. The Writer, the Prophet, the Keykeeper—as one they must combine to overturn fate and change destiny. Yet all three are kindling; one rises all rise, one burns all burn.' The prophecy's voice echoed through the space, but following it, another line of text slowly appeared, the characters狰狞如血: 'Yet the Heavenly Eye has long set a contingency—the moment the Fifth Page Prophecy is triggered, the sacrifice begins.'"

dialogue.content: "'Do you understand now?' Chen Ling's voice sounded in Su Qingyao's mind, carrying a resigned sorrow. 'The three of us, from the very beginning, were destined to become offerings. The Heavenly Eye calculated this step millions of years ago—the Tianji Record's inheritor would be guided by fate to this place, would actively trigger the Fifth Page Prophecy, would personally ignite their own deadly game.'"

text.content: "When the three emerged from the consciousness space, the ruins had already begun collapsing. The Heavenly Eye's pursuit was no longer simple tracking, but a suppression from a higher dimension—it wanted these three to become the key opening the Gate of Sacrifice. Su Qingyao's face was deathly pale, yet she still tightly grasped Chen Ji's hand, refusing to let go."

"'Chen Ji.' Su Qingyao's voice was soft, yet exceptionally firm. 'Whether or not you were using me...' She took a deep breath, tears glistening in her eyes yet stubbornly refusing to fall. 'I won't regret reaching this point.' Her grip tightened. 'So don't even think about pushing me away.'"

"Chen Ji lowered his gaze to those hands tightly gripping his own, and an unprecedented complex emotion surged in his heart. He had calculated everything, calculated the heavens, calculated fate, yet he had never calculated that someone would be willing to journey to the Yellow Springs with him. He opened his mouth, wanting to say something, yet found all words so pallid and inadequate."

dialogue.content: "'...Fool.' In the end, Chen Ji only spoke these two words. But his fingers secretly tightened, interlocking with Su Qingyao's. In this moment, that calculating废柴 disciple finally admitted—his greatest miscalculation in this life was meeting her."

text.content: "The ruins' collapse grew more violent; the Heavenly Eye's oppression grew stronger. But Chen Ji felt a strange tranquility in this moment—for no matter what lay ahead, at least now, he was no longer alone. Chen Ling's figure coalesced beside the two of them; three auras intertwined, forming a subtle balance."

"When the complete content of the Fifth Page Prophecy flooded into her consciousness, Su Qingyao finally understood—their fates, hers and Chen Ling's, had been woven into the same deadly game by the Tianji Record many years ago. And now, the only thing they could do was fight fate to the bitter end—or become the final trump card in Chen Ji's hand to reverse the heavens and earth."
